title: OBKS terms (voice/terms.yaml)
description: Words to use and avoid. Read by people, AI agents (through the digest), and obks check-copy.

use.description: The word or phrase to use.

avoid.description: Words or phrases to replace with `use` (or to never use, when `use` is empty).

topic.description: Optional: when this applies, for example pricing, product names, or support.

reason.description: Why. Short reasons make rules easier to follow.

caseSensitive.description: Match capitalization exactly (for names like a product spelling).
